lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\TalkMqtt\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

vendor/ ships 1 package that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 30 to 32. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.

Nothing in the app calls 1 route outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 2 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
Nothing in the app calls 1 OCS route. OCS is there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
